Name: Animal Crossing Dig Spot Unofficial 1.6.x Update
Author: zonbai
Description:
Replaces the worms dig spot with the dig spot from Animal Crossing.
This updated version also includes an animated seeds spot introduced in 1.6.

Original mod by Lechet
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2129

Downloads.Description:
- If you use any interface or recolor mod that has dig spots, go into that mod's options and disable it's dig spots.
- Delete any prior versions of this mod.
Unzip this file to mods folder.
Supports SDV 1.6.x and SVE

Manifest.Name: (CP) Animal Crossing Dig Spot
Manifest.Description: Animal Crossing Dig Spot and Seed Spot.
